summary: Authored a 15-phase implementation plan for the L^▷ proof system from research report 01, adopting its decisions D1-D5 and recommendations R1-R7 unchanged. Two gate collisions the research missed were found at plan-authoring time and each is now carried by a specific phase: check-metalogic-cycles.sh assertion B asserts upward-import-set EQUALITY against a frozen 8-line allowlist and fails on surplus, so Phase 5 extends it in the same phase as OpenErasure.lean's Theorems imports; and C26 forbids non-trailing underscores in def names, so probe 01's discharge terms are renamed to lowerCamelCase rather than promoted verbatim. The report's own staging mitigation for the 1,400-line validity dispatch was also corrected -- it would have left a sorry in the tree between phases and failed C3, so Phases 6-10 land independently complete block helpers and Phase 11 assembles the two wildcard-free dispatch lemmas.

artifacts.summary: 15 phases, 29 hours, 10 dependency waves: OpenAxioms.lean, OpenDerivation.lean, OpenErasure.lean at layer 0; Conservativity/Open/{OpenAxiomValidity,OpenSoundness,Forward}.lean and Deterministic/OpenCollapse.lean at layer 3; plus the layer table, the cycle-check allowlist, the C14 baseline pairs and the theorem-index rows.
